findings.title: `main` requires a context (`Dependency Review`) that no job emits
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: main.json requires 'Dependency Review / review', emitted by dependency-review.yml job review; guard PASS (8/6 contexts resolve).

findings.title: `enforce_admins:false` lets administrators bypass all required checks and reviews
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: enforce_admins:true in both .github/branch-protection/main.json and develop.json.

findings.title: Production deploy path uses the unguarded `prod` environment, not `prod-approval`
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: deploy prod job environment prod-approval (deploy-do.yml:648); prod migrations (supabase-migrations.yml:38); terraform-apply-prod (terraform-do.yml:204); read-only resolve-ip/terraform-plan keep the unprotected prod env by design (nothing mutates).

findings.title: `require_code_owner_reviews:false` makes the committed CODEOWNERS advisory only
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: require_code_owner_reviews:true in both payloads; scripts/check-codeowners.mjs (syntax + optional team resolution via CODEOWNERS_READ_TOKEN) wired in unit-tests action.yml:146-154.

findings.title: No break-glass / bypass process for branch protection, and no bypass audit trail
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: branch-protection-audit.yml bypass job (weekly + dispatch) lists merged PRs whose head check-runs missed required contexts and opens deduplicated [break-glass] issues (:94-186); docs/RUNBOOK_EMERGENCY_MERGE.md + .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/break_glass.yml; fixture self-test passes. Unexercised: the workflow has 0 runs to date and there are 0 break-glass issues, so the trail has never actually been produced (see BP-P1-004).

findings.title: No drift detection between committed branch-protection JSON and live GitHub settings
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: branch-protection-audit.yml drift job compares committed JSON with live protection, fails + ntfy/Slack alert + uploads artifacts (:43-92); needs BRANCH_PROTECTION_READ_TOKEN (documented; fails closed with instructions). Unexercised: 0 workflow runs to date; the first run is operator-gated and would report the pre-existing divergence (see BP-P1-004).

findings.title: Path-filtered required checks can leave `main`/`develop` protected by checks that never run
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: all required workflows have an unfiltered pull_request trigger (test.yml:10-14, lint.yml:5-10, typecheck.yml:5-10, e2e.yml:19-23, dependency-review.yml:2-4, codeql.yml); scripts/check-required-checks.mjs fails on a filtered required workflow.

findings.title: Required-check guard is not run on pull requests or on branch-protection-only changes
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: unit-tests composite runs scripts/ci/check-required-checks.sh in both the PR gate (test.yml:41) and the deploy gate (validate.yml:88), reading .github/branch-protection/*.json, so a branch-protection-only PR is checked too; fixtures 4/4 PASS.

findings.title: `deploy-do` manual dispatch can target prod from an arbitrary ref, bypassing the develop->main promotion model
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: deploy-do.yml:61-69 rejects deploy_target=prod unless GITHUB_REF=refs/heads/main; the same main-only guard exists for db-restore-test (:52-60), load-test (:67-75) and smoke-check prod dispatch.

findings.title: Security scan jobs are not required checks, so failing scans do not block merges
findings.note: at 7dd0402 'Test / security-scan', 'Test / secrets-scan' and 'CodeQL / Analyze (javascript-typescript)' are required on both branches and block merges; residual: GitHub's 'Require code scanning results' setting (blocking on CodeQL *findings*) is a repo-admin action and not evidenced in-repo, and Chromatic / a11y-breadth remain non-required (documented as repo-admin promotions).

findings.title: Hotfix and emergency-deploy documentation is a stub and partially stale
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: docs/RUNBOOK_HOTFIX.md is a complete procedure (branch-from-main, gates, backport, break-glass pointer, incident reference); RUNBOOK_EMERGENCY_MERGE.md covers the stuck-gate path.

findings.title: Dependabot has no security-update separation or triage SLA, and PR template has no enforced link to required checks
findings.note: at 7dd0402 the SLA is documented (docs/DEPENDENCY_POLICY.md) and dependabot-triage-reminder.yml keeps a weekly deduplicated triage issue; .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md:26 links branch-protection/README.md. Residual: Dependabot security-update separation is a GitHub repo setting, not inspectable read-only.

findings.title: Operator checklists disagree on which prod environments need required reviewers (`prod` vs `prod-approval`)
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: matrix:9-16, RELEASING.md:118-141 and SECRETS_ROTATION.md:28-37 all name prod-approval as the single prod mutation gate; prod is read-only jobs only.

findings.title: check-required-checks guard mis-models explicit job names combined with matrices
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: the guard models explicit job names + matrices (scripts/check-required-checks.mjs:73-90, emittedNames) and scripts/ci/check-required-checks.sh runs a 4/4 negative-fixture suite (PASS).

findings.title: No CODEOWNERS validation; invalid team handles silently disable owner-review enforcement
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: scripts/check-codeowners.mjs + scripts/ci/check-codeowners.sh (fixture PASS) wired in unit-tests action.yml:146-154; CODEOWNERS_READ_TOKEN optional with a documented syntax-only fallback; .github/CODEOWNERS documents the failure mode.

findings.title: PR #279 merged into main with required checks pending and zero reviews - live protection does not match the committed payloads (or an unrecorded bypass)
findings.note: live evidence at 7dd0402: PR #279 (docs/publish-reaudit @ 62a09bac) targeted main, had 0 reviews (GET /pulls/279/reviews = []), and was merged 2026-10-13T02:00:23Z while its required checks were still running - the required 'Test / test (20.x)' job (run 38334811453) started 02:00:21Z and only failed at 02:03:02Z. The committed main.json requires 1 approving review + a CODEOWNERS review + 8 status contexts with enforce_admins:true, so this merge is only possible if the live settings differ from the committed payload or a bypass occurred; no [break-glass] issue exists and branch-protection-audit.yml has 0 runs. Action: run scripts/branch-protection-audit.mjs --mode drift with an admin token, apply/reconcile the live settings, backfill a break-glass record for PR #279 if a bypass is confirmed, and provision BRANCH_PROTECTION_READ_TOKEN so the weekly audit runs.
